decision_reason: The governance script reproducibly rejects revision-suffixed model, control-plan and state filenames even though their JSON contents are valid.

causal_assessment.hypothesis: Revision-2 canonical artifacts were given names outside requirementFilePattern while the revision-1 canonical names still occupied the permitted slots.
causal_assessment.supporting_evidence: scripts/check-ai-control-layout.mjs permits canonical model, control-plan and state names and arbitrary execution-* archives; the failure lists exactly the three revision-suffixed files.
causal_assessment.falsifier: Governance still reports the same invalid-file violations after revision 2 is placed in canonical slots and revision 1 is archived under execution-* names.

control_action.target: Only the six control-evidence filenames for revision preservation and canonical revision-2 ownership
invariants: Keep the active revision-2 state writable by control_loop.py
control_action.impact_limit: Rename revision-1 canonical files to accepted execution-revision-1-* archives and revision-2 model, plan and state to canonical names.

residual_risk: Governance validates filename shape and JSON parsing, not each archived file's phase schema
